findings.severity: low-medium (EFF1: backlog; but the designer's copy edit waits for it or QA runs this list on the new copy)
findings.what: The promise definition learned the lists it was tested on. QA's new fresh list: 12/50 promises (A 12/38), 20/48 false positives (13 new in S22). Regressions: a heading before a negation now hides a real offer ('ניוזלטר: בלי ספאם, רק השראה.', 'עדכוני משלוח ב-SMS: בלי הרשמה ובלי עלות.', 'התראות לוואטסאפ: אין צורך באפליקציה.'), and the English window hides 'No account needed and we'll email the receipt.' New false positives: a product shipped ('המנורה נשלחת אליכם מפורקת'), the tracking line of the order page ('מספר המעקב יופיע כאן ברגע שהחבילה תצא'), a paper invoice ('החשבונית יוצאת אליכם בתוך החבילה'), a refund ('הכסף אמור לחזור אליכם לכרטיס'), field labels ('אימייל (רשות)', 'אימייל שגוי', 'אימייל *'), 'אנחנו שונאים ספאם', 'התאמה מלאה לטלפון: כל פרטי ההזמנה בדף אחד'. Missed forms of the same kind: נתקשר, יחזור אליכם, יעדכן, תודיע, ייצרו קשר, נכתוב לכם, נעביר לכם, 'תשלח' before its subject, 'מגיע אליכם', 'לינק/מס' מעקב', 'הירשמו לקבלת הטבות', English with a channel and no verb.
findings.fix: the heading rule exempts only when the negation negates the heading's channel, and never when the heading itself offers (channel + what is sent); the English negation does not cross 'and'; 'to you' needs a message noun or a channel (product nouns are shipping); TRACKING with a sending/receiving verb only; a two-word label whose second token is punctuation, a parenthesis or an error word is a field; verbs by root and person (נ/י/ת + עדכן, הודיע, חזר, צר קשר, התקשר, כתב, העביר); keep QA's S22 list as a third external file

findings.what: 'any' (and a needs list) still pass a promising line whose words fall outside IMPLIES: 8 'any' mutations (a shipping update in other words, a price alert, English 'on its way', inspiration, 'יהיה זמין', 'שינוי בתאריך', 'חשבון המס', 'כל העדכונים על ההזמנה') and 3 needs-list mutations pass copyIssues.
findings.fix: a promising sentence (processor names removed) that implies no capability is an issue: name what it needs or rewrite; widen IMPLIES by roots (שליח, זמין, תאריך, חשבון מס, השראה, קולקציה)

findings.what: The dummy rules miss Israeli placeholders and stop real Israeli numbers: israel.israeli@…, israel@israeli.co.il, your@email.com, mysite/mycompany, test.user@, 050-000-0001 pass; a homograph of example.com passes even the public build; 03-555xxxx, 050-555xxxx and *2345 are stopped (555 is a US convention). With no override (README Q1), an owner whose real number is in a 555 block cannot publish.
findings.fix: drop the 555 rule for Israeli numbers; add the Hebrew placeholders and my*/your*/test.* templates; refuse a mixed-script domain in contact validation; e2e rows for each

findings.what: The repo guard misses an address after 'mailto:' (its lookbehind excludes ':'), +972 (3) …, 972-3-…, 03.xxx.xxxx, star and 1-800 numbers, '[at]', and skips .webmanifest and .yml files (7/16 planted values reported).
findings.fix: strip mailto:/tel: before matching; widen PHONE (parentheses, 972 without +, dots, *NNNN, 1-700/1-800); add webmanifest, yml/yaml, toml, svg, xml, env examples to TEXT

findings.what: The scanner reads join/concat only on an array literal or a string receiver: a const-bound array, .filter(Boolean).join(' '), .map().join, Array.of, new Array, spread, reduce and String.prototype.concat.call are missed (10/18), and the gate header lists only binary metadata as a limit.
findings.fix: resolve a const-bound array literal and identity chains (filter(Boolean), map(x=>x)); write the remaining forms in the header as a known limit

findings.severity: medium (the customer gets another colour; before HD_PUBLIC=1)
findings.what: A choice made before the product page hydrates is shown but not used. options.spec's product, a real click on the next colour at DOMContentLoaded, 10 loads: 4/10 the swatch stays 'אפור' while the legend says 'לבן חם' and 'הוספה לסל' puts 'לבן חם' in the cart; 1/10 the click is undone; 5/10 right. One ArrowDown after the spec's hydration signal also fails 1/12 and 2/20 (focus on the next value, the room's value checked): the header cart's aria-busy is not the options form's hydration.
findings.fix: on hydrate, adopt the checked inputs from the DOM as the selection (or keep them inert until hydrated, without breaking no-JS); e2e: an early click, phone and desktop, and the cart line matches the checked swatch

findings.what: options.spec's retry hides a lost key, as house.spec (t77): with the first ArrowDown after mount swallowed, the spec's logic passes in 2 presses; a single press fails.
findings.fix: a real hydration marker on the options form, then one press with a long timeout, no retry

findings.what: Studio prices are bound to the card, not to the SKU they were set for: when sourcing moved the default SKU, ₪229 (curtain) and ₪1,299 (rug) moved with it. Curtain: 56/56 options down 5.6-14.9%. Rug: ₪1,299 now on 230x330 (break-even ₪3,605) while 150x200 shows ₪4,909 and 160x230 ₪5,149: an inverted size ladder on the public product page (not for sale, PRE1). No gate warns.
findings.fix: pricing re-decides both (the curtain's ₪269 fix is in progress; the rug too); store the SKU a studio price was set for and have build-catalog warn (public: stop) when the default SKU differs; a check that price rises with size within an axis

findings.what: A story or house list that names a rejected card builds it: build-catalog filters 'rejected' only when it picks for a slot. Mutation: the story naming the rejected floor lamp puts floor-lamp-pleated-walnut-dxyh7 in the story catalog. Only the S22 vitest guard (after prepare:data) catches it; npm run build does not run vitest.
findings.fix: build-catalog hides a named rejected card with a reason (or stops); keep the guard
